purpose: Buddhist creed (Pratītyasamutpāda-gāthā) inscribed on a stūpa
notes: The fragmentary inscription contains only the Buddhist Pratītyasamutpāda formula ('[ye dharmā hetu]prabhavā hetu[ṃ] teṣāṃ tathāgato hy ava[dat / ... ] evaṃvādī mahāśramaṇaḥ'). No historical persons or dates are preserved.
